project_analysis.summary: A global language-learning platform providing gamified lessons, exercises, and progress tracking through interactive content.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To provide an engaging, accessible, and effective way for users to learn new languages through bite-sized lessons.
expected_user_journey: Landing page visit -> Sign up/Login -> Select language -> Complete first lesson -> View progress/streak -> Earn XP/Rewards

boundary_tests: Maximum character limits in user profile
negative_tests: Interrupted internet connection during a lesson
Attempting to access premium features with a free account
accessibility_tests: WCAG 2.1 compliance for lesson interactive elements
Screen reader compatibility for audio-based exercises
Keyboard navigation for all interactive buttons
Color contrast for text and progress bars
integration_tests: User progress sync between web and mobile platforms
Payment gateway integration with subscription services
ui_tests: Visual consistency of gamification elements (icons, progress bars)
Responsive design across different viewport sizes
exploratory_tests: Unconventional navigation paths through the learning tree
Rapid interaction with lesson elements to test race conditions
Testing UI behavior during audio playback
security_tests: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in user profile/social features
performance_test_suggestions: Load testing lesson module loading times
Stress testing leaderboard updates during high concurrency

explorer_summary.summary: Duolingo's homepage promotes language learning with a clean, modern interface featuring prominent call-to-action buttons for getting started. The page includes numerous navigation links and interactive elements, though several resources failed to load (404 errors) and a storage access permission was denied, indicating potential issues with asset delivery or browser permissions.

navigation_analysis.navigation_flow: Primary navigation includes language selection, learning paths, and user account access; secondary links cover about, careers, press, and legal sections; footer contains additional resources and language options.
